description: Morning briefing: check emails, review monitored sites, compile and send summary

steps.prompt: Use email_read (if configured) to check for new emails. Summarize any important messages. If email is not configured, skip this step.
Use schedule_check_pending to find any tasks due today. List them with their status and priority.
Check memory for any sites being monitored (tag: monitor). For each, use browse_url to fetch current content and compare with the stored version. Note any changes.

Compile all findings from the previous steps into a concise daily briefing. Format:

## Daily Briefing — [Date]

### Emails
[summary or 'No new emails']

### Pending Tasks
[list or 'No pending tasks']

### Site Changes
[changes or 'No changes detected']

### Action Items
[any items requiring attention]
Send the compiled briefing via the configured notification channel. Keep it concise for mobile reading.
